title: Mumbai to Pune: Western Ghats EV Express
subtitle: A 2-day family EV road trip through India's mountain gateway

route.kidActivities: Lonavala Hill Station, Imagica Theme Park
Dagdusheth Temple, Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum, Shinde's Chhatri

bestFor: Weekend getaway from Mumbai with hill station scenery
tips: Mumbai-Pune Expressway is India's finest highway — 6-lane concrete road
Reliance BP and Tata Power chargers at expressway rest stops
Charge fully in Mumbai before departure — Lonavala is the key charging point
seasonal: October to March (post-monsoon, lush green hills)
